summary: Master AI tools for investigations and analytics in our expert-led training course. Equip yourself with the knowledge to transform your investigative approach.
lede: AI tools for investigations and analytics help investigators, auditors, compliance and risk professionals examine data and documents. The course covers preparing data, detecting patterns and anomalies, testing investigative assumptions, and checking outputs for bias and false positives; participants also learn to explain AI-assisted findings in clear, defensible reports while retaining responsibility for decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who are at the forefront of investigative and analytical work across various sectors. Whether you are handling compliance, fraud detection, or risk management, AI tools can significantly enhance your capabilities.
modules: Foundations of AI in Investigations and Analytics
Data Sources and Preparation for AI Analysis
AI Tools for Pattern and Trend Detection
Document and Text Analysis Using AI
Using AI for Investigative Hypothesis Testing
Ethics, Bias, and Responsible AI Use
AI in Public Sector and NGO Investigations
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of data analysis and investigative processes. No prior AI or coding experience is required.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
